wordProblems.q: Nora, Mia and Leo each have 11 pencils. Their teacher gives them 16 more pencils to share. How many pencils do they have in all?
Jack has 29 stickers. Jack gives away 14 stickers, then buys 2 packs with the same number of stickers left in each pack. How many stickers does Jack buy?
There are 37 red cars and 30 blue cars in a car park. 38 cars drive away. How many cars are left in the car park?
A ticket costs $9. Ella buys 6 tickets and a snack for $7. How many dollars does Ella spend in all?
Mia buys 3 packs of 5 pens and 2 packs of 7 pencils. How many pens and pencils does Mia buy in all?
83 children go on a school trip. 52 children ride in the first bus. The rest ride in the second bus. How many children ride in the second bus?
A baker makes 3 trays with 12 cookies on each tray. Her family eats 10 cookies. How many cookies are left?
Liam plants 6 rows of carrots with 7 carrots in each row. Then Liam plants 15 more carrots. How many carrots did Liam plant in all?
Ben saves $4 every week for 6 weeks. Then Ben spends $13 on a game. How many dollars does Ben have left?
A library has 6 shelves with 11 books on each shelf. The librarian adds 15 more books. How many books are there in all?
A shop has 4 boxes with 7 apples in each box. The shop sells 20 apples. How many apples are left?
Lily has 54 red beads and 28 blue beads. Lily uses 18 beads to make a necklace. How many beads does Lily have left?
A cook has 4 cartons with 12 eggs in each carton. She uses 13 eggs to bake cakes. How many eggs are left?
Isabella scores 16 points in the first game and 30 points in the second game. Isabella gets 11 bonus points. How many points does Isabella have in all?
A farmer fills 6 baskets with 5 oranges in each basket. He gives 17 oranges to his neighbours. How many oranges are left?
Chloe is reading a book with 86 pages. Chloe reads 32 pages on Monday and 26 pages on Tuesday. How many pages are left to read?
A class has 5 groups with 6 children in each group. 8 children are away today. How many children are at school?
Layla has 5 bags with 5 marbles in each bag. Layla gives 18 marbles to a friend. How many marbles does Layla have left?
A baker packs 2 boxes with 8 muffins in each box. Then she bakes 11 more muffins. How many muffins are there in all?
Jack has $44. Jack buys a toy for $19 and a book for $19. How many dollars does Jack have left?
Henry scores 13 points on Monday, 30 points on Tuesday and 24 points on Wednesday. How many points does Henry score in all?
Noah plants 7 rows of beans with 6 seeds in each row. 10 seeds grow into plants. How many seeds do not grow?
An adult ticket costs $7 and a child ticket costs $6. Leo buys 2 adult tickets and 3 child tickets. How many dollars does Leo spend in all?
Mia is reading a book with 94 pages. Mia reads 22 pages on Friday and 43 pages on Saturday. How many pages are left to read?
A market has 6 baskets with 7 apples in each basket and 5 baskets with 9 pears in each basket. The market sells 38 pieces of fruit. How many pieces of fruit are left?
A cook bakes 6 trays with 9 cupcakes on each tray. The children eat 25 cupcakes. How many cupcakes are left?
Adam has $62. Adam buys a ball for $9 and a hat for $20. How many dollars does Adam have left?
Henry fills 3 jars with 8 strawberries in each jar. Then Henry picks 4 more strawberries. How many strawberries does Henry have in all?
Sara saves $6 every week for 5 weeks. Then Sara buys a kite for $12 and a puzzle for $5. How many dollars does Sara have left?
A school has 4 classes with 5 children in each class. 9 new children join, and 11 children are away today. How many children are at school today?
